name: Kael'thas Sunstrider
shortDescription: Kael'thas Sunstrider, represented in the Shattered Sun and Sunwell research story.
body: The same prince recorded as kael-thas-sunstrider, represented in his Burning Crusade Sunwell campaign guise. This appearance record is not a second person. This is a theater-specific visual alias of the existing kael-thas-sunstrider record, not a separate character. Original image-generation art; not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, size or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the Burning Crusade patch-2.4 client/model before human review. See docs/research/shattered-sun-sunwell-visual-assets.json.
